title: Deiss PRO Coarse Grater & Hand Held Cheese Grater - Sharp Stainless Steel Blades, Non-Slip Handle, Small Cheese Grater for Kitchen, Shredder, Dishwasher Safe
description:
About this item
Ultra-Sharp Stainless Steel Blades for Effortless Grating — Deiss handheld cheese grater features razor-sharp etched blades that easily shred cheese, vegetables, and citrus zest with minimal effort. Ideal for grating hard cheeses, ginger, garlic, or zesting fruits, it’s the perfect metal cheese grater for any kitchen.
Comfortable Non-Slip Handle for Safe Use — Designed with an ergonomic non-slip handle, this hand cheese grater ensures a secure grip while grating, reducing hand fatigue. Whether you're using it as a vegetable grater, potato grater, or cheese grater hand tool, it’s easy to control and safe to use.
Versatile Food Grater for Multiple Ingredients — From mini cheese grater to vegetable shredder handheld, this versatile tool works for all your kitchen needs. Use it to grate cheese for pasta, shred carrots for salads, or zest lemons for desserts. It's the ultimate stainless steel cheese grater for any task.
Safe and Convenient Storage with Protective Cover — Our cheese grater handheld comes with a snap-on protective cover to store the sharp blades safely. It’s the perfect carrot grater and potato shredder for avoiding injuries while keeping your kitchen tidy and organized.
Dishwasher Safe and Easy to Clean — Crafted from durable stainless steel, this small grater is dishwasher safe, making cleanup a breeze. Whether you’re using it as a hand grater for cheese, vegetables, or citrus, it’s built to last without rust or wear.

reviews_5s:
This simple grater is solidly built, comfortable in the hand, and includes a couple of nice features such as a cushioned stabilizing bar at the end that helps hold the grater steady if you’re using it on a cutting board, a protective shield that makes it drawer-safe, and a cleaning brush.

It’s hard to tell from the images and it’s all relative, but I found this to be more of a “medium+ coarse” grater when comparing it to another hand-held grater I have that’s both wider, and also has slightly larger, or coarser, holes. I often found the larger one too coarse so I’ve been getting replacements, with one being a “fine” grater (purchased here on amazon) and now this one. I think this is the winner for most uses and easily produces large shavings of Pecorino cheese. If I wanted to grate a potato or something larger, I’d obviously choose the larger/wider one, but I think this works well for most kitchen needs.

Summary - it’s sharp and makes quick work of hard and soft cheeses, and it should work for vegetables as well. If you’re looking for a well-made, reasonably coarse grater, this is an excellent choice. Recommended.Exactly what I was looking for! I have some other good graters but they are for much finer grating/shredding, so it's a pain when I just need to grate a block of cheese. Takes way longer than it should. Not anymore, thanks to this new grater!

Very durable and sturdy in the hand, comfortable too. It's big so no problem going through the larger blocks of cheese. I appreciate that it comes with the cover as well so that I can store it without worrying about getting knicked when I open up my drawer in the future & may have to dig around for it. It's not too heavy, and feels good quality.

Very fair price point for the quality. Happy with this!I eat pasta almost every day and it's so convenient to have this Deiss handheld cheese grater close by so that I can top my meal with just a bit of cheddar each time.

My clunky, box-shaped grater has served me well up to this point, but it's a bother to pull out such a big grater when I just need a quick topping with a small amount of cheese.

This grater is nice and sharp and also works well shredding vegetables. Thanks to the brush that is included, it’s also much easier to clean than my larger model.

I’m very happy with this product and the price is extremely reasonable.This grater has the feel of a well-built, professional item. It feels sturdy and the rubber grip on the end only adds to that feel. The hand grip is also reasonably comfortable and fits my hand well. This is a replacement for one that I lost and is a bit bigger and FAR nicer than the old one.

It comes with a small brush which I am not sure I'll ever use and a plastic cover which I think is great! This will end up in a drawer with other utensils and the cover will protect it AND me!I am pleased with this grater. It is quite sharp and does a good job of grating both hard cheeses like Parmesan and softer cheeses like Colby Jack. The rubbery handle grip is comfortable in your hand. It washes up well in the dishwasher. I appreciate that it came with a guard, but I probably won't use it. I try to provide both positives and negatives in my reviews, but honestly, I can't think of anything to complain about. Two thumbs up!Grater is compact and well-made. Handle is very robust, grating teeth are sharp and well-sized. I make a lot of pizzas and pre-shredded cheese is terrible, so I grate a lot of cheeses. It's much easier to handle than my old box grater, and takes up way less space. It cleans up will in the dishwasher. I couldn't be happier with this item.It's hard to find an established brand on this website, wading through the random 6-letter names. It has a cover, the bottom is rubber so it won't slip when you rest it on a plate or counter. Overall a good value for $10.

I got this for free through Amazon Vine.Great addition to the kitchen—super sharp and perfect for thick shreds of cheese or veggies. The non-slip handle makes it easy to use, and it feels sturdy. Simple, effective, and gets the job done.Great grater!This Deiss PRO Coarse Hand Held Cheese Grater is perfect for my kitchen !
I use it every day to grate ginger for my tea among other things like garlic 🧄 , radish, cheese 🧀 etc. !
It is convenient to hold and handle !
Sturdy!
Durable !

All in all. I am really happy with this grater and would definitely recommend it ! 👍😍
